name: Portrush Adelphi
accommodation: 34 rooms: doubles, deluxe kings, twins and family suites
suitableFor: Couples, friends, families and dog owners
dogs: Dogs welcome inside for an additional charge (tourism listing)
beachAccess: About 0.32 miles from East Strand and 0.43 miles from West Strand, per tourism listing
confirmedFeatures: Red Sail Room restaurant, bar, room service, lift, 24-hour concierge, laundry service, Wi-Fi, games room, cycle hire, accessible rooms
overview: Portrush Adelphi is a 34-room hotel on Main Street, about a third of a mile from East Strand. It has the Red Sail Room Italian restaurant, a bar and a games room, with family suites and accessible rooms available. Dogs can stay for a charge.
surfTripFit: Both town beaches are within a short walk, and family suites and dog-friendly rooms suit groups and travellers with a dog.
